status: Bounded measurement and report accepted; source publication and task closure are root actions
scope: Three authored dependent episodes, eighteen turns, three configurations; development comparison, not held-out/SOTA/learning-gain evaluation

reviewMethod.programmatic: Read all 54 saved results and 54 actual-selector audit records; recompute scores and summary; reconstruct each exact inference prompt from the versioned runner and training selector; compare eligible receipt times, model identity, usage and expanded proposal.
reviewMethod.semanticReading: Read every current-selector displayed answer and all five failed outputs/raw selections, including the no-history clarification, wrong-flight and schema-withheld cases; inspect protocol and reporting limits.

verified.historySessionIsolation: One separate session per condition/episode; six fresh sessions per episode for no-history; no state sharing between conditions.
verified.sourceManifest: All eight runtime/runner source hashes match. Original eight-test file hash is retained as history; current test and reporting-helper hashes match reportingFiles. Runner source is unchanged from the earlier independent review.
verified.targetedTests: 9 comparison/scoring/reporting tests passed independently after the final reporting fix.
verified.usage: All actual calls have complete token counts. Reporting helper now leaves incomplete totals null and keeps known subtotals separately.
verified.deadlines: No saved latency exceeded 35 or 40 seconds; the offline runner did not enforce native deadlines.
verified.perScenarioTable: Final report per-scenario values match the independently recomputed 6/6/6, 5/4/5 and 5/6/6 rows.

failureInterpretation.finding: The accepted answer states the truthful current ground-hold release but omits required overall_readiness uncertainty. This is a semantic coverage failure, not invented departure clearance. Nonempty structural acceptance does not establish a complete answer.
failureInterpretation.registerStatus: Root reports a distinct ordinary-assistant-path note in the existing open semantic register.

failureInterpretation.finding: Four task misses: two valid clarification responses with no referent, one internally sourced answer about TRN102 instead of expected TRN103, and one schema-withheld selection containing four fact IDs beyond the maximum of three. identityNotMatched=4 must not be described as four wrong-aircraft claims.

limitations: All arms use the same selector, evidence expansion, validator and retry policy; lexical top-six retrieval is not an unconstrained RAG or published external system.
History is current referent/intent state, not a full dialogue transcript. No selected aircraft is supplied, unlike common native usage.
Claim values are expanded from facts. Scores chiefly measure selection, identity, requested coverage and uncertainty, not unrestricted prose quality.
A correctly labelled non-current claim fails the predeclared strict current-only rule; that is not automatically temporal hallucination. No such claims occurred in this run.

Supported irrelevant extras can pass when required content is present; clarity and complete relevance are not scored. complete/incomplete fields concern required factual values, while unknown coverage is separate.
Retrieval missingProperties comes from the subset while validation uses the full eligible world.
There are only three dependent episode contexts and one seed; 54 responses are not 54 independent samples. No significance or general superiority claim is supported.
Fixed condition order and offline execution make latency descriptive; actual engine stop reasons are unavailable and inferred from token counts.
No retry occurred in this comparison, so it adds no observed retry-recovery evidence.
The lexical arm achieved the best observed task success; no production prompt was revised to erase the current-path loss.
No graph-specific need was demonstrated, no graph database was added, and no learner grading or app-semantic repair is claimed.
preservation: Run, answer keys, prompts and frozen historical research were not changed by this reviewer. Initial wrong-environment startup failure is retained in the manifest. Existing videos are unchanged.
remainingActions: Root publishes source/evidence, closes task #70 as measurement/report completion, preserves semantic issue #60, and confirms service restoration separately. Course #30/#31/#32 remain separate.
